verdict.rationale: monday.com's own pages say users can build custom agents inside the product by describing a workflow in plain language, defining the goal and setting the rules. Admins can scope each agent's board access, and developers can ship agent skills, which adds configuration depth. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on agent configuration options (instructions, tools, knowledge, triggers), independent or hands-on corroboration that agent building works as described.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build and configure my own custom AI agent within the product

citations.quote: Build agents for your exact needs. Define the goal, set the rules, watch the results.
Describe any workflow in your own words to create a unique agent in minutes.
Scope each agent's board access from the admin, audit every action it takes
Ship new reusable workflow blocks, agent skills, and board column types.
